channel.title: Dr. V. P. Jha — Visual Mathematics Notes
channel.description: Measure theory, probability, topology, and research explained with intuition and rigour.

item.title: Why a Borel σ-algebra is larger than the collection of open sets
item.description: Begin with open sets, then watch complements and countable unions build the Borel world.

item.title: Outer measure: why we cover a set from the outside
item.description: The infimum is how interval covers approach the size of a set as tightly as possible.

item.title: PDF versus CDF: two views of the same distribution
item.description: Density is local; distribution is accumulated. The integral connects the two.

item.title: What an open ball actually tells us about a point
item.description: An open ball translates the metric into a usable local neighbourhood.
